remarks: Tucked back from the road, 2 Westwood Drive has its own private entrance and the rent price is the actual price - WITH NO ADDITIONAL FEES. This Newer, very pretty apartment in sought after Westwood features an open designer kitchen with new granite countertops + stainless steel appliances, sunny rooms lined with large windows, cool, new laminate floors, central air, gas heat, excellent closet space and personal, in-unit washer & dryer. The popular & elegant Westwood community features impeccable on-site maintenance and grounds care. This fabulous, apartment is pet-friendly, has off-street parking, a small gym and 24-hour security. Pets are Ok, Dogs must be less than 35 Lbs. only, 2-Cats Ok or 1-dog and 1-cat OK ($300 fully refundable pet deposit required). Westwood is a No Smoking Community. Please have interested prospects submit the Westwood application uploaded in supplements with a credit check through Applyconnect only.  This apartment has just been vacated and quickly being made to sparkle!
